bullets.text: Mobile Boost Creates 49,000 Businesses - **VodafoneThree** research indicates improved connectivity could add £6.6bn to the UK economy.
AI-Native Networks Emerge - **SK Telecom** outlines its strategy for integrating AI into future 6G networks.
Cargill Scales Private 5G - Cargill expands private 5G to 50 sites, enhancing connectivity across its operations.
Samsung and Orange Expand RAN - The partnership aims to increase vRAN and Open RAN deployments across Europe.
5G Standalone Transformation - **Ericsson** highlights the imminent benefits of 5G Standalone for UK mobile networks.
AI Reshapes Network Planning - AI's influence on 6G planning emphasizes flexibility to accommodate evolving demands.
Telefónica Launches Edge Services - **Telefónica** activates Edge Computing services across five Spanish cities.
Google's $15B Subsea Cable - **Google** plans a major subsea cable to enhance AI infrastructure and connectivity.
